children: Overview
Singapore AI agent builder's preliminary Q2 revenue rose 38.8% qtr/qtr to $13.9 mln
Gross margin expanded to 79.5% from 67.7% last quarter, driven by higher-margin agentic revenue
Company withdrew financial guidance amid transition to specialized AI agent business
Outlook
Company withdraws previous financial guidance due to strategic transition to AI agent business
Amber expects to provide updated guidance after establishing sufficient operating history and forecasting visibility
Company plans to present expanded agent portfolio and financial framework at Investor Day before year-end
Result Drivers
AGENTIC REVENUE MIX - Co said higher-margin agentic revenue, including initial contribution from A-MM, drove gross margin expansion and profitability
PRODUCT LAUNCHES - Ambre and MIA, first specialized AI agents, launched and contributed to revenue growth
WEALTH MANAGEMENT DEMAND - Stronger demand for diversified and newly launched investment products drove wealth management solutions revenue
